_comment: A debug-mode Healer with rc statuslines:3 maps the level (^F), so a corridor on map row ROWNO-1 shows beyond the first status row's text on a 24-row terminal. Setting statuslines to 3 from the O menu runs wintty.c tty_preference_update(): new_status_window()'s cl_end() erases that corridor, and newclipping() clips the map to 20 rows. Moving the travel cursor to row 19 makes getpos.c cliparound() scroll the map up one row, and the hero's later steps leave it scrolled.
